Title: Choice of annotation data significantly impacts automated reconstruction of genome-scale metabolic networks
Summary: Shows that the choice of genome annotation source substantially changes automated draft genome-scale metabolic network reconstructions and their quality.

Title: A thermokinetic genome-scale metabolic model of the dominant archaeon Haloquadratum walsbyi reveals physicochemical constraints shaping carbon use
Summary: Reconstructs a thermokinetic genome-scale metabolic model of Haloquadratum walsbyi to explain how physicochemical constraints shape carbon use in hypersaline ecosystems.

Title: A Key Piece of the Whole-Cell Puzzle: Mechanistic signaling for interpretable whole-cell models
Summary: Argues that mechanistic signaling is needed for interpretable whole-cell models because it couples extracellular cues to gene regulation and metabolism.

Title: A hybrid metabolic graph neural networks based observer for metabolic modeling with sparse data
Summary: Develops a hybrid metabolic graph neural network with nonlinear state estimation to model metabolic systems from sparse, noisy bioprocess data.

Title: Multi-dataset INST 13C metabolic flux analysis reveals robust fluxes but variable metabolite pools
Summary: Presents a miniaturized INST 13C-MFA workflow that finds robust fluxes but variable metabolite pools, aimed at C1/C2 bioprocesses where stationary 13C-MFA is uninformative.

Title: SABIO-RK in 2027: enzyme kinetics data with modernized framework and enhanced data access
Summary: Reports a redesigned SABIO-RK enzyme-kinetics database for systems-biology modeling, enzymology, and training of machine-learning predictors.

Title: Spatial control of enzyme orientation at the lipid droplet interface enables regio- and chemoselective metabolic flux
Summary: Controls enzyme orientation at the lipid-droplet interface to spatially organize multienzyme cascades and direct regio- and chemoselective metabolic flux.

Title: Redirecting Metabolic Flux to Minimize By-Product Formation Enables Efficient De Novo Biosynthesis of Chlorogenic Acid in Escherichia coli
Summary: Engineers Escherichia coli for de novo chlorogenic acid biosynthesis by raising NAD(H) supply and redirecting flux to reduce by-product formation.

Title: Itaconic Acid Production from Corn Stover Hydrolysate by Engineered Escherichia coli with the Weimberg Pathway and Carbon Flux Redirection
Summary: Engineers Escherichia coli with the Weimberg pathway and carbon-flux redirection to produce itaconic acid from corn stover hydrolysate.

Title: Metabolic engineering of industrial Aspergillus niger for efficient production of trans-aconitic acid
Summary: Metabolically engineers industrial Aspergillus niger for efficient trans-aconitic acid production as a bio-based platform chemical.

Title: Metabolic engineering of plasmid-free Escherichia coli for enhanced biosynthesis of O-succinyl-L-homoserine
Summary: Metabolically engineers a plasmid-free Escherichia coli strain for enhanced biosynthesis of O-succinyl-L-homoserine.

Title: Growth-decoupled terpene biosynthesis from CO2 by a photo-heterotrophic coculture
Summary: Establishes a sucrose-secreting photoautotroph-heterotroph coculture for growth-decoupled terpene biosynthesis from CO2.

Title: A Cryptic Plasmid from Stutzerimonas stutzeri DIA-8 Provides a Basis for Shuttle Vector Development in Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas putida
Summary: Characterizes cryptic plasmid pM27181 from Stutzerimonas stutzeri DIA-8 and derives minireplicons as shuttle vectors for Escherichia coli and Pseudomonas putida.
